title: H465: FinDPO continuous sentiment scoring as FinBERT upgrade in H174 pipeline
rationale: arXiv:2507.18417 'FinDPO: Financial Sentiment Analysis for Algorithmic Trading through Preference Optimization of LLMs' (July 2026) introduces the first DPO-aligned financial LLM with a logit-to-score conversion that produces CONTINUOUS sentiment probabilities rather than FinBERT's discrete {positive, negative, neutral} classification. Key results: 11% accuracy improvement over supervised fine-tuned models; Sharpe ratio 2.0 under 5bp transaction costs. H174 uses FinBERT with a binary threshold (score >= 0.18 = positive) — this is crude: FinBERT probability 0.19 is treated the same as 0.95. FinDPO's continuous scoring could: (1) improve position sizing (scale by score magnitude), (2) raise WR by using higher threshold, (3) provide a better filter when combined with H464's two-stage framework. H465 tests whether replacing FinBERT with FinDPO (or using FinDPO score alongside FinBERT) improves H174 OOS WR above 81.8%.

hypothesis_log_entry.title: FinDPO Continuous Sentiment Scoring Upgrade for H174 PEAD Pipeline
hypothesis_log_entry.mechanism: DPO-aligned LLMs produce better-calibrated continuous sentiment scores than supervised fine-tuning (FinBERT). In financial NLP, calibration matters: a barely-positive score should carry less weight than a strongly-positive score. FinDPO's 'logit-to-score' conversion creates a signal that can be used as a continuous weight or higher-confidence gate.

variants.A: FinBERT score multiplied by FinDPO score (ensemble) — gate stays at product > 0.05
variants.B: FinDPO score alone >= 0.25 (higher threshold than FinBERT 0.18)
variants.C: FinDPO continuous score → position sizing (size proportional to score)

design.gate: OOS WR > 81.8% AND mean_ret > 6.89% AND n >= 20 events

implementation_notes: FinDPO model needs to be pulled from HuggingFace — verify package name on PyPI first (hallusquatting defense)
Run pip-audit after installing any new model package
Evaluate on same H174 OOS events (21+ confirmable events) to allow direct comparison
Caution: FinDPO may not have been trained specifically on earnings 8-K filings — verify training data before assuming transfer
hypothesis_log_entry.priority: MEDIUM — after H464 which has stronger theoretical backing and public data
hypothesis_log_entry.prior_art: H174 CONFIRMED; H163 CONFIRMED; H168 NOT CONFIRMED (speaker-weighted FinBERT); H317 NOT CONFIRMED (FinBERT + EPS filter reduces n below gate)
